title: WHEN LOVE MAKES THE YEARS FLY

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Laban said, 'It's better that I give her to you than to some other man. Stay here with me.' So Jacob served seven years to get Rachel, but they seemed like only a few days to him because of his love for her." - Gen 29:19-20 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Here is one of the most beautiful lines in Scripture about love: Jacob served seven long years for Rachel, "but they seemed like only a few days to him because of his love for her." Seven years of hard labour felt like a handful of days. That is the power of love — it transforms the way we experience even difficult, demanding work.

When we love someone or something deeply, sacrifice stops feeling like sacrifice. The parent up all night with a sick child, the caregiver serving a frail relative, the worker toiling for a cherished dream — love makes heavy burdens light. It is not that the work becomes easy, but that love changes how we carry it.

This gives us a window into the Christian life as well. When we truly love the Lord, obeying Him and serving Him no longer feels like grim duty. Jesus said His yoke is easy and His burden is light (Matt 11:30) — not because following Him costs nothing, but because love makes the cost a joy. "His commands are not burdensome" to a heart that loves Him (1 John 5:3).

Is your walk with God feeling like heavy duty? The answer is not merely to try harder, but to love Him more. When love for Christ grows, even years of service can feel like days.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. What does love make light for me that would otherwise feel heavy?
2. Does serving God feel like joyful love or grim duty?
3. How might a deeper love for Christ change how I carry His call?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, let my love for You grow so deep that serving You becomes a joy rather than a burden. Turn my duty into delight through a heart that truly loves You. Amen.
